programme.title: Owner presidents, the end of an era
programme.desc: More and more professional football clubs in France belong to large financial groups. Owner presidents are fewer and fewer in number. Laurent Nicollin in Montpellier, Waldemar Kita in Nantes, Joseph Oughourlian in Lens and Jean-Pierre Caillot in Reims discuss the specificity of their position, their passion for their club, but also the difficulties of their task

programme.title: The Wild East of Poland
programme.desc: The documentary focuses on one of the last wild regions in Europe, the Biebrza Valley. The largest National Park in Poland is a habitat for beavers, otters and a whole host of water birds... Germany, Poland. 2023. documentary film

programme.desc: In Egypt, scientists are studying the evolutionary history of whales. Viewers can learn how these unusual creatures lost their legs and had to return to the sea... Great Britain. 2023. documentary film

programme.title: In the footsteps of a great mammoth
programme.desc: At the National Museum of Natural History in Paris, work is underway to reconstruct the skeleton of one of the largest mammoths that lived on our planet... France. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. The Ice Age became an arena of struggle between Neanderthals and representatives of Homo sapiens. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan investigate how two competing species have adapted to extreme conditions. Backshall explores southern Germany, where he discovers traces of the life of early humans and their ability to deal with prehistoric predators using advanced tools and weapons. In turn, Strachan examines the differences in anatomy and skills between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. It turns out that despite the physical advantage of the former, the latter showed greater abilities in long-distance running and technological innovation. The key technology that gave them an advantage was the sewing needle, which allowed them to create tighter clothing. The decisive moment that led to the extinction of Neanderthals was global warming and environmental changes that left Homo sapiens as the dominant species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E03
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. With the melting of ice and global warming, a completely new era in Earth's history begins. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan set out to search for the land that connected Britain with the Old Continent before the end of the Ice Age. Steve goes deep beneath the waves, and Michaela investigates the course of the natural disaster that formed the North Sea and divided Europe. The disaster was a catalyst for the further development of the first people who began to create boats. In the Arctic, Michaela works with the British Antarctic Survey drilling for ice cores. The material obtained in this way will reveal how the world's climate is changing. It turns out that global warming may create ideal conditions for the start of a new ice age. Steve will test whether people would cope if the Earth were plunged into eternal frost again. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Animal Wars – Cold Fury | E01
programme.desc: Animal species will be presented that can use their amazing features to defeat sometimes larger opponents. By perfecting them, they became true masters of communication, combat and camouflage. The world of snow, extreme cold and icy waters means that animals are always ready for battle. Panthers and polar bears living in frosty areas are real warriors. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions – The Fat Years | E02
programme.desc: The life story of young lions. The everyday challenges they have to face throughout their adolescence will be shown. The triumphant moments after the hunt will be presented, as well as the dangers to which... Germany is exposed. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – In extreme conditions | S01E03
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. Sharks, which appeared on Earth before dinosaurs, have adapted to life even in the most unfavorable environments. Scientists are investigating the secret of their evolutionary success. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Wildlife Conservation: From Yellowstone to the Yukon – Grizzly Bears | E02
programme.desc: Viewers will see the process of implementing a new ecological concept. It assumes the creation of a nature conservation corridor that will reach from Yellowstone National Park to Yukon... France. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Nile: the final river – On wild waters | E02
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. The Victoria Nile creates foamy rapids and waterfalls. In South Sudan, Africa's largest wetland area is being created - the Sudd, which is inhabited by, among others, antelopes, great herons and shoebills. From its source in East Africa to the deserts of Sudan, the Nile flows through a wide strip of the wildest nature. Hippos and crocodiles live here. Over 400 species of birds breed and hunt along the Victoria Nile, including: African razorbills and white-bellied storks. During the dry season, giant elephants search for water in grassy areas. North of the Nile, the hilly savanna is noteworthy - the home of a rare species of antelope: the kobus. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.title: Scandinavia – In the light | E01
programme.desc: Scandinavia is one of the places in the world where there is a polar night and a polar day. This is accompanied by months of darkness, and then the sun returns to the sky. There is also Midsommar, which is a gradual shortening of the day until the next night. Winter in Scandinavia is marked by the arrival of the polar night. This is a period when the sun does not rise for a long period of time. Animals, plants and people who have to adapt to extreme conditions will be presented. Germany. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Fall | E01
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. It's fall in Canada, and the cold winter will soon begin. The animals have little time: they must make the most of the available food before it disappears under the deep snow and ice. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Animal Wars – Cold Fury | E01
programme.desc: Animal species will be presented that can use their amazing features to defeat sometimes larger opponents. programme.title: Lion's Principles – Einstein's Principles | E05
programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. The dry season is coming. Lions hunt and enjoy domination of their territory. Former recluse Einstein becomes king of his own flock. South Africa. 2025. nature series

programme.title: The most dangerous sharks
programme.desc: Residents of certain areas of the USA and Australia are particularly vulnerable to attacks by bullhead sharks. Former navy diver Paul de Gelder and marine biologist Craig O'Connell try to find out whether this fish species is actually one of the most dangerous in the world... South Africa. 2025. documentary film

programme.title: Earth seen from space – New perspectives | S01E01
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. Cameras in space allow you to admire life on Earth from a completely different perspective. You can observe animal migrations, seasonal changes and sea tides. Viewers will follow elephants searching for water, discover new penguin colonies, and look at ice circles that pose a threat to seals. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Bullies of Baltimore
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Animals at Play: Rules of the Game (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep2 «Animals at Play»…Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists' cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweed–all following specific rules that hone social bonds | Baby animals love nothing more than play. From cats that enjoy the game of chase to dolphins that play catch, new scientific research has shown that collaborative play is one of the most important aspects of animals' learning, development, and socialization. Looking at how some unexpected species are getting in on all the fun, this programme uncovers the secrets behind their games | Director: Dan Perowne

programme.title: Battle Of the Alphas: Scrappy (S2E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2022. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2022. S2, Ep4 «Battle of the Alphas»…Celebrate small but mighty animal warriors armed with sheaves of scary weapons. Admire nutrias' stink bombs; honey badgers' savage, needle-like choppers; black-tailed gulls' razor-sharp beaks; and the killer talons on dive-bombing peregrine falcons | From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, our planet is a battleground as animals go head to head with their own kind, in Battle of the Alphas | Director: Elizabeth Trojian | Cast: Mark Clermont

programme.title: Animals at Play: The Power of Play (S1E1). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep1 «Animals at Play»…Across the natural world, young animals spend much of their time playing. From cats that love a game of chase to chimps that can solve puzzles, new research now reveals that play is at the heart of almost everything an animal learns. And some unexpected species are getting in on all the fun and games. In the jungles of Thailand, clouded leopard cubs are chasing, climbing, jumping on each other and play fighting. And they play these same games over and over again. But why? It is all about the release of dopamine and endorphins – the body's reward chemicals. They give the animals a feel-good factor, which makes these games highly addictive. And that repetition is vital. The more they play, the more they hone their skills and eventually these cubs will become formidable tree-based hunters. But play isn't practiced by just a few species. Scientist are discovering that it is a lot more widespread than previously thought. Even some reptiles have an appetite for fun. The komodo dragon is the largest lizard on earth and a cold-blooded killer to boot. Professor Gordon Burghardt has been studying them in captivity for the last 20 years and has started to see their playful side. Using objects like paper bags and buckets, he has observed that they like playing with things on their heads and it led him to wonder what they might gain from doing this. He thinks it might replicate their feeding behaviour – burying their heads deep inside a carcass to get food. It is one of the first examples of play behaviour ever recorded in a reptile. Komodo dragons aren't the only unexpected animals that love playtime. From juggling otters to sledging crows, scientists are discovering that play is a serious pastime across the natural world and some animals are willing to risk their lives to do it. In the forests of Thailand, Gibbons hurl themselves huge distances through the canopy. It is a daredevil method of locomotion called brachiating. But 15 metres up, one slip could prove fatal and it is something that the gibbons have to be prepared for. So, to really get to grips with their treetop world juveniles take an enormous risk. It is thought they allow themselves to fall by momentarily letting go of the branches. It is a risky tactic but one that teaches them how to react if they fall for real. It isn't just how animals play that matters, it is what they play with that could prove critical to their survival in the wild. Young carnivores are among the most playful animals on the planet and science suggests there's a good reason for that. Their lives depend on their ability to hunt and they like to practice on objects. Marlice Van Vuuren has been looking after orphaned cheetahs for over 30 years and she uses object play to train them for their return to the wild. A game of ball is perfect for helping them learn how to chase down objects that move in unpredictable ways. They also need to make split-second decisions about when to pursue prey and when to call it quits. To sharpen their decision-making skills, Marlice uses an industrial sized game of cat and mouse otherwise known as a lure. It gives her cheetah a mental work out as well as a physical one – helping them assess when they are likely to catch prey. So, for predators, play is a mental work out as well as a physical one. And in some species, it doesn't just give the brain a work out, it could cause parts of the brain to grow. For the first eight years of its life, a calf will rarely stray from its mother's side and with food on tap, they have plenty and time and energy for playing. programme.title: In the animal world. 10 s.
programme.desc: A program about the amazing world of wildlife, its representatives, their habits and habitat. The fauna of our planet is many-sided and diverse, and this is not surprising, because living conditions in different parts of the Earth are very different. You cannot find even the smallest place on the map - neither on land nor in the ocean - where living organisms do not live. Flying and crawling, with and without shells, furry and smooth, big and tiny, menacing and funny creatures, all of them are our neighbors on the Planet and need careful and respectful treatment. The program will introduce viewers to individual representatives of the motley fauna and talk about the amazing abilities of our smaller brothers to survive and adapt to harsh living conditions. Russia, 1968, educational

programme.title: Conversations with animals. History of the Nile crocodile
programme.desc: At the farm, a Nile crocodile remembers the glory days. But times and climate changed, and the savannah of the pharaohs was replaced by a desert. Can the crocodile that survived the ice age and kill the dinosaurs survive global warming? 2019, educational

programme.title: In the animal world. 22 p.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: d/s National parks: treasuries of life. National Park of Croatia "Plitvice Lakes"

programme.title: d/f Fear in the Savannah
programme.desc: The film reveals fear as a basic and primitive emotion in the animal world. It is a key survival mechanism, creating vigilance and helping to avoid threats. This documentary immerses viewers in exploring how fear works in animals to protect them from danger and ensure the survival of the species. Learn how fear helps animals navigate dangerous environments and cope with the unknown, and how this emotion is hardwired into their genes to ensure their survival

programme.title: d/f Panda. Way home

You will learn how cubs that were born on the territory of the reserve grow and prepare for a new life in the wild, what habits they have and what characters adult pandas have. You will also see rare footage of the work of Chinese specialists who, in order to study these animals, dress up in special panda costumes and are ready to follow their trail for several days

programme.title: BÍ MẬT MITTERRAND - MITTERRAND CONFIDENTIEL
programme.desc: Tập 3Danielle Mitterrand bị tổn thương khi sự tồn tại của Mazarine, cô con gái bí mật của Mitterrand và mẹ cô Anne Pingeot được chính thức công bố. Cô bỏ đi, chán ngấy những bí mật của chồng. Ở cấp cao nhất của chính phủ, cảm xúc đang dâng cao. Tổng thống một lần nữa phải đối mặt với một cuộc khủng hoảng đang đe dọa hình ảnh của ông trước công chúng. programme.title: BÍ MẬT MITTERRAND - MITTERRAND CONFIDENTIEL
programme.desc: Tập 4 Căn bệnh của ông khiến François Mitterrand lo lắng và suy yếu ngay khi ông phải tới Strasbourg để nhậm chức tổng thống Pháp tại Liên minh Châu Âu. Tuy nhiên, anh đã tìm thấy sức mạnh để đi tiếp trên con đường mà anh đã đặt ra cho mình: truyền tải thông điệp của mình cho thế hệ tương lai và hòa giải hai gia đình của mình. programme.title: ĐẤT NGHỆ THUẬT - TERRA ARTISTIKA
programme.desc: Étienne Moyat - Một ngàn lẻ một bức phù điêu Những sáng tạo của Étienne Moyat phản ánh sự tôn trọng và tình yêu sâu sắc của ông đối với thiên nhiên. Là một thợ đóng tủ được đào tạo bài bản, anh ấy tạo ra những tác phẩm độc đáo, hoành tráng cho các dự án cao cấp. Bên cạnh đó, anh còn theo đuổi thực hành vẽ tranh mãnh liệt và bản năng. programme.title: GIẾT NGƯỜI Ở PÉRIGORD VERT - MEURTRES EN PÉRIGORD VERT
programme.desc: Ở Périgord, Isabelle Maurin, Nữ hoàng mới đăng quang của Araucania, được tìm thấy bị chặt đầu trong khu vườn của lâu đài mà cô vừa thừa kế. Đây không phải là vụ giết người đầu tiên liên quan đến gia đình này. Emma Lambert, một trung úy cảnh sát trẻ đến từ Bordeaux, tiến hành cuộc điều tra cùng với Sacha Besson, một trung úy của hiến binh địa phương. programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: THỢ SĂN MÁU: SỰ TRỖI DẬY CỦA QUÁI VẬT LAI - BLOOD HUNTERS: RISE OF THE HYBRI
programme.desc: Gabriella bị thôi thúc bởi sự trả thù sau khi một con quái vật lai tàn sát gia đình cô. Trong nhiệm vụ của mình, cô gia nhập một đội Thợ săn máu và họ cùng nhau tiến hành cuộc chiến chống lại các lãnh chúa tàn nhẫn của thế giới ngầm, gây ra một cuộc đối đầu tàn khốc.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: THẠCH HẦU TRỞ VỀ - THE MONKEY IS BACK
programme.desc: Vị cứu tinh của mọi người, Stone Monkey, đã mang lại hy vọng cho một cô bé tuyệt vọng mà anh hứa sẽ nhận ra. Nhiều năm sau, Stone Monkey bị đánh bại trong trận chiến với Thần chiến tranh ba mắt, khiến hắn mất đi sức mạnh và rơi xuống phàm trần. Liệu anh ta có thể thực hiện lời hứa của mình với cô gái và ngăn chặn Thần Rừng hủy diệt trái đất?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH 2 - THE GREY MEN 2
programme.desc: Ông trùm Hội Tam Hoàng Song tìm cách xóa sạch hình ảnh của mình và chiếm lấy ghế thị trưởng của Laika trong bối cảnh chế độ đang thay đổi. Anh ta phải đối mặt với sự thiếu hụt kinh phí mặc dù đã thông đồng với các quan chức, đồng thời được cánh tay phải và người thi hành án của mình phạm tội để tăng cường quỹ và quyền lực của anh ta. Ngay khi Song tin rằng thành công sắp đến thì động lực giữa ba người lại có một bước ngoặt bất ngờ…
